item.alone_journey.crystalline_heart.too: A heart condensed from crystal, the crystals on it still shifting in color.
Regenerates 1 shield every 10 seconds after taking damage
Higher armor and armor toughness increase shield capacity and regen speed
item.alone_journey.bleedingshield.toolti: A shield forged from congealed blood, the blood still seeks to erode its wielder.
Every 2 armor points or 1 health point sacrificed converts to 1 armor toughness
item.alone_journey.adaptive_flesh.toolti: A squirming piece of living tissue that seems to learn alongside your pain.
Each hit of a damage type grants 1 layer of adaptation (15% per layer, max 5); taking a different damage type decays all existing layers by 1
item.alone_journey.parryshield.tooltip.d: Raise this shield at the moment an enemy strike lands for a perfect defense.
item.alone_journey.parryshield.tooltip.p: Block within 1s of raising: full immunity, reflects 70% damage and weakens the attacker for 3s (1s parry cooldown)
item.alone_journey.parryshield.tooltip.b: Held up longer: absorbs 80% of the damage
item.alone_journey.painstrike_hammer.too: A heavy war hammer; swinging it demands a toll in rhythm.
Hits inflict Vulnerability for 10s; repeat hits extend 5s and add +1 level. Each triggered hit deals +50% damage and removes one level
